how: Kotlin same-file extract/inline labels on real commits, written 2026-11-14 by reading each diff (harness/LABELLING.md definitions), before any Kotlin engine code or run. Candidates from commit-message search and a loose new/removed-function body-overlap search. Practice: okhttp, kotlinx-coroutines. Held out: ktor, exposed. Plus the 300-commit practice datasets (square/okhttp at 5c34f67a3f, Kotlin/kotlinx.coroutines at ead082131c): every loose candidate (30), labelled blind by two independent Fable agents following harness/LABELLING.md, 2026-11-15, before any engine run on these datasets.
